capabilities: select fragments via lists, headings, tables, quotes or code blocks
convert lists into tables, list tables and tree grids
render fragments as tabs, cards, columns, directories or timelines
generate mermaid, PlantUML and markmap mindmaps from lists
chain processors together for combined effects
extras: Also distributed as a markdown-it/Vuepress plugin, an online app, and a min-sized version installable via BRAT; detailed usage documentation lives on an external wiki rather than in the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render ordinary Markdown fragments as other block types without adopting new, plugin-locked syntax.

relations.evidence: recommended to use together with another plugin AnyMenu developed by the author

summary: Markdown extension renderer that turns selected fragments (lists, headings, quotes, code blocks) into tables, tabs, cards, timelines, mindmaps and diagrams.
